en.ariaConfirm: Click again to confirm restarting the desktop app
en.ariaDesktopOnly: Restart the desktop app (desktop build only)
en.ariaScheduled: Restart scheduled; the page is about to disconnect
en.ariaWarnArmed: Restart the desktop app anyway, interrupting running tasks
en.blockedFallback: A plugin install/update is running; restart again once it finishes
en.blockedSuffix: ; restarting stays blocked until it finishes.
en.clickTwiceInterruptSuffix: ; you can still click twice to restart, but that would interrupt them.
en.confirmAgainSuffix: ; after clicking Restart you will be asked once more.
en.defaultHint: Restarts the entire DeepSeek Harness desktop app. Use it after changing plugins or settings so they take effect.
en.desktopOnlyPanel: This is not the desktop build; this panel works only inside the desktop app.
en.desktopOnlyRow: This is not the desktop build; this row works only inside the desktop app.
en.entryFooterHint: Shows at the bottom of the sidebar (above Settings); click twice to restart
en.entryHeaderHint: Shows on the right side of the conversation header, always within reach
en.entryPanelHint: Shows at the top of the sidebar list; clicking it opens the restart panel in the main area
en.entryRowHint: Adds one row under Settings → General
en.hideContactOff: Shown: the item reappears below Settings as usual.
en.hideContactOn: Hidden: the account menu keeps only Settings and sign-in/out, so it can't be misclicked.
en.panelDesc: Restarts the whole desktop app. Conversations in progress are saved normally on shutdown — nothing is lost.
en.restartingPageHint: Restarting… this page is about to disconnect.
en.riskAck: I understand this interrupts the work listed above (files being written may be left half-done)
en.scheduledRestart: Restart scheduled: the window will close shortly and reopen by itself.
en.setDesc: Choose which entries are shown — changes apply immediately and are stored on this computer. The /restart-desktop command and the master switch live in the plugin config (config.command / config.enabled).
en.sweepAutoLabel: Sweep leftover snapshots on every start
en.sweepDetailA: DSH's change snapshots create a directory in the system Temp folder for every session; hard kills and crashes leave them behind as orphans.
en.sweepDetailB: Only directories that existed before this start, were never written since, and are at least 24 hours old are swept — active sessions are never touched.
en.sweepDoneNone: : scanned {n} directories, nothing to clean up
en.sweepDoneRemoved: : removed {n} leftover snapshot directories, freeing {mb} MB
en.sweepFailedTail: ; {n} could not be removed (probably still in use).
en.sweepOff: Off: nothing in Temp is ever touched.
en.sweepOn: On: swept once on every start.
en.warnAgainHint: Click "Restart anyway?" once more to proceed.
en.wholeApp: Restart the whole DeepSeek Harness desktop app
en.wholeAppTooltip: Restart the whole desktop app (ends the current instance and opens it again)
